plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/22126
Crypto-theft coding convention used throughout this batch: stolen funds coded as confidentiality data variety Virtual currency (data_victim Victim organization unless customer wallets were drained), integrity Fraudulent transaction for the unauthorized transfers, and the USD loss in impact (Asset and fraud). No template tag; coded as hacking Exploit vuln (logic flaw in self-listing verification), vector Other, asset S - Other (smart contracts/pools), cloud Other. Liquidity-pool funds belonged to users (who are being reimbursed) -> data_victim Customer. The prior May 2024 ALEX bridge hack was linked to Lazarus, but no actor is named for this one -> Unknown. Impact $8.3M. No NAICS tag; 523999 used. Country/headcount Unknown. Single source. dbir_year 2026.

summary: On June 6, 2025 attackers bypassed a flaw in the self-listing verification logic of Bitcoin-based DeFi platform ALEX Protocol and drained several liquidity pools of about $8.3 million (8.4M STX, 21.85 sBTC, 149,850 USDC/USDT and 2.8 WBTC). It was ALEX's second major hack in just over a year. The ALEX Lab Foundation committed to reimburse affected users in USDC from its treasury.
